response.original_title: Fergie's Dream Team - The Official Story of The United Team That Made History
response.overview: They're the team of the nineties. The most exciting set of players to emerge in British football in a decade.  Names not only of today, but that will live on in the hearts of football supporters for generations to come.  Here we tell the story of how Alex Ferguson created one of the world's greatest teams. We talk to United's manager about each of his star players: how he signed them, how he rates them, and how he sees them as part of United's team of the future.  We also ask United's players about their successes in the past and their hopes for the future.  Exclusive interviews, fascinating insights, and plenty of scintillating action make Fergie's Dream Team a must-buy for all connoisseurs of football.
response.title: Fergie's Dream Team - The Official Story of The United Team That Made History
